P1 — NAMED.md:1353 (context in hunk): `THE COVERAGE GAP IS MEASURED... | A10 | V` is marked VERIFIED, but the row names only a gate (`A10`), not the mutant that reddens it. The prose also claims a safety property (“walk can never borrow a write from an unrelated function”) that is broader than the cited measurement: A10 can read “1 of 22 stores is outside every function range” and perhaps “fallback cap is 36 instructions,” but that does not establish the negative invariant. This violates the repo law that every VERIFIED row names its red mutant and needs a gate/mutant that can fail if the cap or provenance logic actually let a write from another function through.

P1 — SESSION_NOTES.md:257–258 (added s296): “two NEXT_PROMPT blocks moved VERBATIM to `docs/pick-archive.md` …” is not supported by the shown diff. No `docs/pick-archive.md` changes appear, no NEXT_PROMPT hunks remove two whole blocks, no path:line is given, and no digest/byte-count evidence is cited for “VERBATIM” or “11,978 B.” If the move happened, the PR omits it; if it did not, this claim is false and the docs chain is being described as verified when it cannot fail on actual input.

P2 — docs/sessions/sessions-278-279.md:3: “Rotated out … by `scripts/session_rotate.py`” asserts an automated rotation, but the PR adds no such script, no mutation harness, no gate output, and no evidence that rotation was faithful or failable. This is hygiene/claim risk: it presents manual docs movement as tool-verified without path:line or instrument evidence.

P2 — docs/sessions/sessions-278-279.md:14–15: archived Session 278 citations like `evidence/m313_event_map.txt` and `scripts/m313_event_map.py` were moved from repo root into `docs/sessions/` without rebasing or path:line precision. If Markdown links resolve relative to the file, these become broken; even if repo-root relative, the original evidence citations still lack line anchors. This weakens evidence traceability after rotation.

P2 — SESSION_CURSOR.md:1: “10 review findings, all accepted” is a process claim with no evidence citation or mutant/gate record. It is also adjacent to a docs-only status update that repeatedly uses verification language (“all accepted,” “pinned,” “MERGED”) without pointing to an assertion-backed record. If this is meant to justify closeout, it should cite review artifacts or at minimum a precise path:line.

P2 — NAMED.md:1354 (changed B25 header): the header now states `MERGED s295 as #319 -> main 1556ce9`, and SESSION_NOTES says the squash title carries post-review numbers. These are immutable external facts asserted with no citation. They are not table VERIFIED claims, but they matter because the header is being used as the authoritative closeout marker; a wrong merge SHA/title claim would mislead future sessions.

P2 — SESSION_NOTES.md:259–260: `11,978 B (warn 12,000)` is presented as a size measurement, but no instrument output or path:line evidence is cited. If cap enforcement matters, the byte count should be computed and printed by a checked script or at least cited to a generated evidence line; otherwise this is unverifiable documentation arithmetic.
